fix_found: Canonicalized objective keys and trace values through G2 to remove signed zero; real failing regression preserved in slice 09.
assumptions: Host adapters/solutions are trusted bounded immutable deterministic code/values and perform no hidden objective queries.
Invalid candidates stop as method-failure; primitive/evaluation Exceptions retain actual charged partial state; fatal JVM Errors propagate.
A visited node may finish semantics using its last available fuel unit; the next node/loop transition is refused.
Search with no current point adopts without score visits; otherwise both scores consume AST fuel after candidate archive insertion.
archive-solutions is positionally aligned with objective-front and keeps the first representative for equal canonical objectives.
G1 PreparedPortfolio construction is a host preparation responsibility; make-adapter separately measures fixed-G2 preparation elapsed time.
Replay compares every returned field except timing, with the same task instance, AST, adapter version, options and seed.
Only ordinary Clojure host functions are accepted for required adapter function fields; no generic callable framework is introduced.

timing.thread_cpu: measured current-thread CPU delta if enabled/supported, else null
timing.preparation: adapter preparation elapsed-ns carried only under timing.preparation
